rubric.visuals: whole pitch visible; bowler visible and not a stick; batter not a stick; stumps look like stumps and fall; lighting/readability; trail/aim markers; sports-game feel
rubric.gameplay: line/length do something measurable; reverse/conventional still works; batter tries to play; bowled/lbw/beaten happen for the right reasons; challenges still make sense
rubric.controls: sliders AND keyboard change line/length/pace/wrist and the on-pitch marker moves immediately; bowl/pause/replay still work; player can see what they aimed vs what happened

learned_from: Cricket 24 / Big Ant — broadcast / bowler's-end camera that shows the whole wicket
Don Bradman Cricket — length buttons (yorker/full/good/short), coloured pitch marker, Big Eye
WCC / Real Cricket — on-pitch landing grid and sports HUD
Super Over / arcade titles — readable arcade bodies, umpire call splash

loops.notes: First client rewrite. Physics line/length fixed, but camera sat too high: pitch was a postage stamp and players shrank to blobs. Aim marker hard to see.
Dropped the camera behind the bowler. Whole pitch and length map readable. Bowler still cropped at the waist; figures still too abstract.

Reframed so bowler, umpire, full pitch and batter sit in one shot. Stumps smash on bowled with BOWLED call. Short-wide defends, full-leg is beaten by late reverse. Chips + sliders + hawk-eye show aimed vs pitched. Three-ball proof matches to ~1cm.
